audience: small shops and warehouse teams that track stock in InventoryMod

useCases.title: Find products below their minimum stock
useCases.text: Search the products with a stock status filter. Read the dashboard summary for the low-stock and out-of-stock items.

useCases.title: Check the stock of one SKU
useCases.text: Find a product by SKU or barcode. Then read its quantity and reserved stock in each warehouse.

useCases.title: Review open purchase orders
useCases.text: Search the purchase orders by status. Open one to see it.

useCases.title: Create or update a product
useCases.text: Create a product with its SKU, or change the fields of one product. Stock levels do not change.
